post.title: Termius wants $10 a month to sync your vault. tern wants nothing.
post.caption: Three fresh grudges: a paid SSH vault sync, a transcription subscription with a minute cap, and PDF editors that charge at the download button.

segments.quote: and termius wants paid plan just to sync the vault.

cues.say: Termius wants ten dollars a month

cues.cap: So: tern. Native, on your Mac.
cues.say: [quick] So: Tern. Native, on your Mac.

segments.quote: Microsoft 365's Transcribe needs a paid subscription

cues.say: Microsoft three-sixty-five wants nine ninety-nine a month

cues.cap: So: sada. Whisper, on your PC.
cues.say: [quick] So: Sah-dah. Whisper, on your PC.

segments.gripe: Free PDF editors that charge at the download.
segments.quote: And some of the "free" PDF editors that I tried wanted me to pay just to download the edited file.

cues.say: Free PDF editors. Pay to download.

cues.cap: “And some of the "free" PDF editors that I tried
cues.say: [sarcastic] And some of the free PDF editors that I tried

cues.cap: wanted me to pay just to download the edited file.”
cues.say: wanted me to pay just to download the edited file.

cues.cap: All built out of pure spite.
